title: Number of alternative symbols at a position
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet, let $u \colon \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \alpha$ be a word of length $n$ over $\alpha$, and let $i$ be a position. Then the set of symbols $a \in \alpha$ with $a \ne u_i$ has cardinality $\abs{\alpha} - 1$.
hypotheses_covered: u is a word of length n over α
i is a position in Fin n
replaced:
For any word $u$ and position $i$, the number of alternative symbols at $i$ is
$|\mathrm{choices}(u,i)| = |\alpha| - 1$.
